findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a full run uses parallel pytest or a direct Vitest/Jest command.
This prints the command before runner modifications. In src/forge/review.py:451-452, narrow_command rewrites it before execution: parallel pytest receives --maxprocesses (src/forge/fasttest.py:122-125), and direct Vitest/Jest receives --maxWorkers. Forge's own forge.toml:6 uses parallel pytest, so the displayed command differs on a normal supported path. Print the final execution command and cover a rewritten command in the command-level regression test. This leaves the exact-command clause unmet in: "forge test --full prints the exact command it ran before its result, and the guide says a full run covers only forge.toml's test command".
